$Comment: The skeleton for the skill jobs on the feast board, posted only on a server running MMO Skill Tree. It
It takes the season and the listing from Harvest_Feast_Contract_Base. Requires keeps the jobs off a
server without MMO Skill Tree: the plain hytale:mod_installed condition at the top, with Min 1, drops
this file and every job built on it at load where that mod is missing, so nothing reads or reports
them, and the board's optional skill slot shows no gap. A job built on it writes no Requires of its
own, since a child's Requires replaces this one whole, mod gate and all. Boards posts every child in
that slot, the band Harvest_Feast_Skill, which only these jobs carry.
A child names its skill in its one GAIN_XP objective and writes its own Rewards.Claim, which replaces
the feast base's list: a little favor with Martha and XP in that skill. Like every job on the board,
the pay waits at the board until the player collects it, so a full bag never costs anyone a reward,
and a job finished in the feast's last hours waits there until the board is back next year. The
board's pay table and Festival Favor stay with the feast's own jobs, so a server with MMO Skill Tree
earns festival tokens and Festival Favor at the pace of one without. Each child takes its words from
the keys its id spells, in harvestfeast.mmo.lang.
